the managers file still carries `awards` per entry, and `saved_awards` still reads every `facts.json`. The site does not read `awards` on a manager. It builds the four season numbers from `weeks`. Drop `awards` from the entry and bump `MANAGERS_SCHEMA_VERSION`, with the site types in the same step. Both repos.
